name: pipe_pressure_drop_colebrook
title: Pipe pressure drop with the Colebrook-White friction factor
summary: Friction pressure drop of n-pentane in a straight pipe (16 mm diameter, 10 m): Darcy friction factor from the implicit Colebrook-White equation checked against an explicit approximation, linear and total pressure drop, dynamic pressure.

origin.course: ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory model (2006), curated as a CoolSolve example

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip, EES_ok/pressuredrop.EES, EES 9.920); ULiège original TM-0315 holds byte-identical equations with stored values within 0.05 %
verification.notes: 25/25 variables compared: 11 within 0.1 %; DELTAP within 0.50 %, f within 0.56 %; mu/nu/Re up to 5.7 % from EES-vs-CoolProp n-pentane transport-property formulations (explained in README).

related_external: CoolSolve examples/pressuredrop.eescode (same model, kept in CoolSolve as a test case)
CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip: EES_ok/pressuredrop.EES (EES original re-saved, EES 9.920, stored solution used as reference)
thermo_models TM-0315 (modeles/perte de charge VL060830.EES, EES 7.458, byte-identical equations)
